name: Spanish page chrome reads in Spanish, not English
description: On /es pages the UI chrome (nav links, tab names, buttons) must actually be in Spanish, demonstrably different from the English text on the equivalent /en page. The test compares the two locales rather than hard-coding an expected Spanish string, so it passes only when content genuinely changed language. Proper nouns (team and source names) are allowed to stay unchanged.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /en and read the nav labels and primary tab/section names
Navigate to /es and read the same nav labels and tab/section names

Verify the Spanish page's UI chrome text differs from the English chrome text for the same controls (the translated labels are clearly a different language, not byte-identical English). If the /es chrome renders the same English words, the test fails.
